class Fireball
  attr_reader :position, :velocity, :damage

  def initialize(origin:, direction:, speed:, damage:)
    @position = origin.dup
    @velocity = {
      x: direction[:x] * speed,
      y: direction[:y] * speed,
      z: direction[:z] * speed
    }
    @damage = damage
  end

  def cast
    move
    apply_effect
  end

  private

  def move
    @position[:x] += @velocity[:x]
    @position[:y] += @velocity[:y]
    @position[:z] += @velocity[:z]
  end

  def apply_effect
    # abstracted: engine handles collision, damage, cleanup
  end
end

def cast_fireball(origin:, direction:, speed: 1.0, damage: 10)
  Fireball.new(
    origin: origin,
    direction: direction,
    speed: speed,
    damage: damage
  ).cast
end
